notes: Event times now follow your NinjaTrader time zone, with safer strategy outputs and popout fixes.
changelog: Markers, blackouts and countdowns now use your NinjaTrader time zone, so they line up with your bars.
Strategy outputs no longer report an imminent release when nothing is scheduled, and the data source shows Degraded when the connection drops.
Each chart gets its own news popout that can be closed, and alerts fire in realtime only.
